facts.value: Initializes Final Destination's map-type object 3 and its changing-background controller. It also invokes common collision-joint setup using the object's map ID and JObj; therefore its role is not exclusively visual. The descriptor's {0,3,0} joint record participates in that map-3 setup, without establishing a more specific visible asset identity.

evidence.why: Initialization, deferred release and process guards.

facts.rationale: Separates the three distinct flag roles and preserves the initialization order.
facts.value: Sets startup gate xC4_b0 true, clears all lv_gobj slots, initializes the state field to zero, clears advancement flag xC4_b26, and sets color-ready flag xC4_b27. It then enters state 1, sets b012 to 1, clears demo-suspension flag xC4_b1, and registers the deferred callback that clears xC4_b0. Background processing remains blocked until both suspension flags are clear; xC4_b27 is a color-transition readiness flag, not the startup gate.

facts.rationale: Corrects generated-effect completion and preserves the unconditional trailing updates.
facts.value: Skips background-state processing while xC4_b0 or xC4_b1 is set. Otherwise it updates the current state, queries a successor only while xC4_b26 is true, and enters a nonzero successor immediately; state entry resets xC8. The 1–17 cycle combines timer or Hand-health eligibility with AObj flag/frame tests, material-overlay readiness, and color completion. The late grLib_801C96E8 checks read Ground.x10_flags.b4, which the material-overlay path clears and sets; they are not generator-completion checks. Ground_801C2FE0 and lb_800115F4 run outside the suspension guard.

facts.rationale: Replaces an unsupported visibility claim with the demonstrated rotation-amplitude behavior.
facts.value: Contributes procedural X/Y wobble to Final Destination's background object 7 and aligns its optional visual-effect generator with joint 5. The background sequence ramps the amplitude of the applied rotation; this does not by itself establish that the model moves into or out of view. The exact visible component remains unidentified.

evidence.why: Motion integration, bounds and generator guard.

facts.rationale: Preserves numeric dynamics without an unsupported exact-duration guarantee.
facts.value: Each update adds acceleration to each angular velocity, multiplies velocity by 0.99, and clamps it to ±(pi/180)/20 radians per update. Integrated X and Y angles are bounded to ±15 and ±10 degrees respectively; exceeding a bound clamps the angle, directs velocity inward, and resamples inward acceleration with magnitude in [(pi/180)/1000,(pi/180)/200). Applied rotations are multiplied by xDC. While resident in state 9, the controller adds 1/180 to xDC and clamps above 1; state 10 subtracts 1/58 and clamps below 0. These floating-point updates do not establish an exact maximum tick count. Generator alignment requires both xE0 and xE0->appsrt.

facts.rationale: Corrects generic fade terminology and the terminal-state claim.
facts.value: Per-update coordinator for Final Destination's background sequence: sets advancement eligibility from time or selected Hand-health thresholds, adjusts object 7's rotation amplitude in states 9 and 10, requests looping camera quakes in states 10 and 11, schedules randomized RGB transitions in state 15, and runs the color updater. It does not select or install the successor itself, and state 15 is not terminal in the 17-state cycle.

evidence.why: Mode guards, increments, quakes and rejection expression.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exceptional state-3 behavior and exact random-color expression rather than normalizing them.
facts.value: Outside internal stages 0xB0/0xFB, sets xC4_b26 when xC8 > 1800, then increments xC8. In those special stages, states 1,3,5,7,9,12 set the flag when the Hand-health query is below 0.7,0.6,0.5,0.4,0.3,0.2 respectively; state 15 has no HP trigger. These are flag-setting conditions, not mandatory dwell guards: state 3 entry already sets the flag true. States 9/10 ramp object 7's rotation multiplier by +1/180 or -1/58 with endpoint clamps, and states 10/11 request looping quakes. In state 15, color-ready permits a new target with each RGB component 0 or 30 and duration 60–119. Rejection excludes (30,30,30) and any candidate whose red and green match current red and green; the expression compares green twice, ignores current blue, and leaves target alpha uninitialized. The color updater runs afterward.

facts.rationale: Corrects track-7 terminology and identifies the late readiness source.
facts.value: Reads the controller's numeric state, color-ready xC4_b27, selected AObj state from managed slots 0–4, and material-overlay readiness from slots 0,4,5. Animation query argument 7 selects animation categories; the routing table supplies joint indices, including joint 2 of slot 3 for states 9/10. It computes zero or a successor without directly writing controller state. The caller forwards nonzero results to grLast_8021B920, which resets xC8, stores the new state, and performs entry actions.

evidence.why: int definition, numeric successors and slot-5 reads.

facts.rationale: Makes the numeric return domain and source ambiguity explicit.
facts.value: State-successor query defined as static int (Ground_GObj*), returning 0 for no transition or a state identifier 1–17. Its controller has six managed slots, with coordinated animation checks over slots 0–4 and later readiness checks also using slot 5. The source forward declaration instead spells the return type bool; retain that declaration/definition discrepancy rather than interpreting the result as merely Boolean.

evidence.why: Selection mask and distinct flag tests.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact exit predicates and distinguishes animation masks, flag tests and material readiness.
facts.value: Returns 0 by default. When queried, states 1,3,5,7,12,15 return their numerical successors immediately. States 2,4,6,8,11 require all five slots 0–4 to pass grAnime_801C83D0, which tests AObj flag 0x40000000. State 9 asserts that the AObj selected from slot 3, joint 2, category mask 7 exists and requires curr_frame == 100. State 10 uses grAnime_801C84A4 on that selection, testing the distinct flag 0x04000000. States 13 and 16 require color-ready plus material-overlay readiness on slots 4 and 5 respectively; state 14 requires slot 5 readiness, and state 17 requires slot 0 readiness before returning 1. The caller's xC4_b26 and suspension guards determine whether this query runs.
